items.source:
Repackage to the given destination so that it can be launched using '
java -jar'.
items.translation: 打包到指定的目标位置，以便可以使用'java -jar'启动。

items.source: IOException - if the file cannot be repackaged
items.translation: IOException - 如果无法重新打包文件。

items.source: libraries - the libraries required to run the archive
Create a new Repackager instance.
items.translation: 创建一个新的Repackager实例。

items.source: destination - the destination file (may be the same as the source)
items.translation: destination - 目标文件（可能与源文件相同）

items.source: Writes a signature file if necessary for the given writtenLibraries.
items.translation: 在必要时为给定的writtenLibraries写入签名文件。

items.source: Repackage the source file so that it can be run using 'java -jar'.
items.translation: 重新打包源文件，以便可以使用'java -jar'运行。

items.source: Sets if source files should be backed up when they would be overwritten.
items.translation: 设置是否在覆盖源文件时对其进行备份。

items.source: backupSource - if source files should be backed up
lastModifiedTime - an optional last modified time to apply to the archive and its contents
items.translation: lastModifiedTime - 一个可选的最后修改时间，用于应用于归档及其内容。

items.source:
Utility class that can be used to repackage an archive so that it can be executed using
'java -jar'.
items.translation: 可用于重新打包归档文件，以便使用 'java -jar' 执行的实用类。

items.source: IOException - if a failure occurs when writing the signature file
items.translation: IOException - 如果在写入签名文件时发生失败

items.source: source - the source archive file to package
writer - the writer to use to write the signature file if necessary
items.translation: writer - 如果必要，用于写入签名文件的写入器

items.source: Phillip Webb, Andy Wilkinson, Stephane Nicoll, Madhura Bhave, Scott Frederick
items.translation: Phillip Webb, Andy Wilkinson, Stephane Nicoll, Madhura Bhave, Scott Frederick
